items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I used to play jobs when he set up.

ctx.x: They worked together with Paul Barberin too. Yeah, we worked together with Paul. I mean anything back in the 30s, back then. No.

Oh, more about the Joe Longagne. I know nothing about him except he led a brass band. Did he play dance bands too? Yeah. I used to play jobs when he set up. What kind of trumpet player was he? Was he a straight man or played variations? No, no. I was mostly a straight band. I see. Did he just use orchestrations or would he play some Dixieland numbers? He used to play Dixieland numbers.

You were talking about the tempos. You said there's a difference between the bands as far as tempos. What do you mean? Some play slower than others? Yeah. Some bands keep better time and others? Some keep better time. Who are some of the drummers that you think keep good time?
